description: Compare the monthly payment, interest rate, RPSN (APRC), total cost and interest of a given mortgage amount across 6 Czech banks, sorted from cheapest. Applies each bank's LTV and small-loan surcharges and limits. Use for 'which bank is cheapest for X CZK'.

all_applicants_under_36.description: True if every applicant is younger than 36 (UniCredit waives the 81–90 % LTV surcharge).

fixation.description: Rate fixation period: 1R, 3R, 5R, 7R or 10R (years). Numbers 1/3/5/7/10 are accepted too.

property_value.description: Property price or valuation in CZK. Used for LTV surcharges and bank LTV limits. Optional.

name: compare_mortgages
title: Srovnání splátek hypotéky u 6 bank
